scripts.text:
[Gomer]
You are carrying so much. Drop off some of your luggage and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
你身上背了這麼多東西。放下一些行李，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
So how's that Pilebuncker working out for you?
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
你的堆樁重錘用起來怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
I'm a retired Mechanic and I don't think I have any business with you.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
我已經退休了，是個機匠，和你沒什麼事可談。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
So? What does it feel like to be on a Madogear?
It's something that's not allowed for those who failed to seek out their own path.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
怎麼樣？駕駛魔導機甲是什麼感覺？
只有沒能走出自己道路的人，才不被允許擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Me? I retired a long time ago. Because I got into an accident... got badly hurt and won't be able to ride again. I am upset about it.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
我？早就退休了。一次事故讓我身受重傷，再也不能駕駛機甲。這讓我很難過。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
So I've decided to stay here forging gears for Madogear.
Huh? I'm not saying I have any complaints about this work.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
所以我決定留在這裡，為魔導機甲打造齒輪。
嗯？我可沒說不喜歡這份工作。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Forced to do something you don't like, there is nothing more miserable than that.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
被迫做不喜歡的事，沒有什麼比這更痛苦的了。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
There are people who are happy just being props, you know, like being the wall for someone to lean on.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
有些人甘願當個配角也很開心，比如成為別人可以依靠的那堵牆。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
That makes me feel good and I am about to make a new gear. I want you to help me. What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
這讓我很高興，也讓我想打造一套新齒輪。我需要你幫忙，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I am not that interested.
scripts.translation: 我沒那麼感興趣

scripts.text: What are you going to make?
scripts.translation: 你打算做什麼？

scripts.text: Where do you get the materials?
scripts.translation: 材料從哪裡弄？

scripts.text: I brought the materials.
scripts.translation: 我帶來了材料

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Nothing I can do
about it then.
See you next time!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
那我無能為力了。
下次再見！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Um, a huge metal stick that could smash an opponent in one hit!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
嗯，一根巨大的金屬棒，一擊就能把對手砸個粉碎！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
It doesn't look fancy, but I've designed a spring-loaded device to attack with great strength.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
它看起來不花哨，但我設計了一個彈簧裝置，能以巨大的力量進行攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
It's concealed, so when you find a chance, one shot could put an opponent in critical condition!
I can't wait to see it in action!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
它藏有機關，抓住機會一擊就能讓對手重傷！我迫不及待想看它實戰了！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
If you were to imagine how good this kind of weapon could be, I will make it come true.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
只要你能想像出這種武器有多厲害，我就能把它做出來。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Bring me 200 Steel, 30 Flexible Tubes, and 1 Brocca. I could make what I just described with those materials.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
給我200個鋼鐵、30根柔軟的管子和1把布里卡。我就能用這些材料做出剛才說的東西。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
You should be able get steel from many monsters like Kobolds.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
許多魔物都會掉落鋼鐵，比如犬妖。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Flexible Tubes are more rare, dropped by Metalings around Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
柔軟的管子比較稀有，艾音布羅克和裡希塔樂鎮附近的金屬波利會掉落。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Lastly, finding a Brocca is very hard, but you should be able to do something about it. Haha, go get it!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
最後，布里卡很難找，不過你總會有辦法的。哈哈，去弄來吧！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
You haven't brought all of the materials that I asked for.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
你還沒有帶齊我要求的所有材料。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
I have a habit of giving up what I've been making and trying to make new things when the inspiration comes up.
You'd better hurry!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
我有個習慣，靈感一來就會放下手頭的東西，轉而嘗試新點子。你最好抓緊！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Oh, I've been waiting. You didn't come on time, so I was wondering if you forgot about it. Please wait there a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
哦，我一直在等你。你來得不準時，我還以為你忘了呢。請在那邊稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
It's done. What do you think? Not bad, eh? Although I made it myself, I have to say it's pretty decently done.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
完成了。你覺得怎麼樣？還不錯吧？雖然是我自己做的，但我必須說，做得相當不錯。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Combination of weight, volume and look at its color and gloss. It catches my heart!
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
重量、體積、顏色和光澤搭配得恰到好處，真讓人心動！

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Uh, with little improvement, it could be mass produced and delivered. I'm sure I can make more of these so I will give this one to you.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
嗯，稍加改良就能量產交付了。我肯定還能做出更多，所以這把就送給你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gomer]
Oh, and it turns out that I didn't need all that Steel after all. So here, take most of it back.
scripts.translation:
[戈麥]
哦，結果我發現其實不需要那麼多鋼。所以，拿回去大部分吧。
